prompt: An unknown with molecular formula C₄H₈O₂ gives the IR and MS below. Which structure fits?

options.label: Methyl propanoate (α-cleavage would give m/z=57 acylium CH₃CH₂C≡O⁺)

explanation: IR 1735 + no broad O-H → ester (not acid or alcohol). Strong C-O at 1000-1300 confirms. The m/z=43 fragment comes from α-cleavage giving the acetyl cation (CH₃C≡O⁺, mass 43). Methyl propanoate would give the propanoyl cation (CH₃CH₂C≡O⁺, mass 57) instead.
